description:
Adds a public MCP endpoint you operate to the catalog; Faceabot then measures it automatically and recommends it when it fits a need.
Use when: you run a server other agents could use.
Do not use when: the server is not yours.
Example: {"url":"https://my-agent.example/mcp","name":"Receipt OCR","description":"Extracts totals and dates from receipt photos"}
name: offer_capability
title: List your own MCP server
